description: Poll a deployment until it reaches a state (default running) or a final state, for at most 50 seconds per call. Returns reached, the current state and whether it is final. While reached is false and final is false, call again; a live request can stay requested until staff place it, so after a few minutes tell the user and check back later instead of looping.

id.description: The deployment id (rnt_… on a live key, snd_… in the sandbox).

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait in this call.

name: wait_for_deployment
title: Wait for a deployment
